text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
After this...
We're doing a few laps at 70% max effort, right?
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's keep your heart rate up high.
Yeah, let's keep that heart rate high.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"To increase maximum oxygen intake
and improve endurance"...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Understood! By the way,
isn't that number of reps a bit vague?
choice_data_list: I want to adjust accordingly based on the numbers and how you're doing.
I want to adjust accordingly based on the numbers and how you're doing.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, that would be more efficient.
In that case... are you sure it's alright to leave it to you?
choice_data_list: Yeah. I'll be keeping a close eye on you!
Yeah. I'll be watching closely!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Then I'm counting on you!
I'll focus on swimming!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Training with Almond Eye was progressing smoothly.
Communication between us was going better than ever before... or so I felt.
choice_data_list: (Her body is getting even stronger, and...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We'll keep an eye on her for a bit longer, but entering real races starting in the Classic year shouldn't be an issue.
If so, what we ought to decide soon is—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Even further beyond the Shinzan Kinen...
You mean her 'major goal' for the Classic year, right?"
choice_data_list: What suits you best is most likely medium distance.
What suits you best is likely medium distance.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Furthermore, looking back at the data, she seems quite versatile. In that case, the orthodox Classic Triple Crown or Tiara routes—
choice_data_list: You can achieve either Triple Crown...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Hmm...
The Classic Triple Crown route, or the Tiara route...
choice_data_list: ...Still having trouble deciding?
...Still having trouble deciding?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Late starts, races... I was always focused purely on what was right in front of me.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
“Still, my criteria for choosing is set in stone.
A race that makes me truly want to 'win'!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I remember having a conversation like that before.
In other words, if we can just find something
that truly moves her heart—
—Mind if I squeeze past ya for a second?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me for interrupting your chat.
I went and left my towel right over there.
choice_data_list: (This girl is—Lucky Lilac.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Graceful in demeanor, carrying an air of composure.
This girl from Almond Eye's generation was—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Lucky Lilac has completely broken away!
With a burst of speed distinctly different from the rest!
Crossing the finish line over a length ahead of 2nd place!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho...
Thank you all very much for your cheers.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Unshaken even while jostled in the pack, she claimed her brilliant debut victory with a model-student run, showing both courage and sharp race sense to find a clear path.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She continued to run solidly after that,
even winning graded races right away.
She is currently one of the most anticipated Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Well, thanks for having me.
...See you in class, Ai-san.
choice_data_list: (Come to think of it, aren't those two in the same class?)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...Lala looks like she's gained a bit of muscle.
Her gait looks different."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Would it be all right
if I watched her training for a bit?
choice_data_list: Yeah, no problem at all.
Yeah, I don't mind at all.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Well, shall we get going?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Hmph...!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
......
Pace keeping: flawless.

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text: ...Ah! Hey. Take a look over there.
choice_data_list: （……Huh? Over there…?）

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
choice_data_list: (The "tyrant" Orfevre...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There are currently seven Umamusume who have achieved the Classic Triple Crown.
She is the newest "sovereign" among them.
Due to her haughty demeanor, she is known as the "Tyrant."

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
She's watching Lucky Lilac...
So those rumors were true after all.

text_block_list.name: Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
Being personally scouted out by that Orfevre...
Well, she definitely has the talent for it.

text_block_list.name: Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
The Hanshin Juvenile Fillies is next, right?
A Junior Class GⅠ leading into the Tiara route...
I wonder if the generation's first GⅠ will belong to that girl.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Paying no mind to the Trainers' gossip,
Almond Eye intently watches Lucky Lilac's
training.
choice_data_list: ...Are you really that curious about her?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...Even before I contracted with you,
I had watched her run many times."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
She's serious, listens well to her teachers...
She's a girl who can handle anything flawlessly!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
There were even plenty of times when Lala served as our role model.
Even so, compared to back then—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
She has grown even more now.
...
choice_data_list: Ai?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Hey. Would it be alright if I went
to watch the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...I was a bit surprised.
Because I thought Almond Eye would say
she 'wants to face off.'"
choice_data_list: Of course that's fine, but are you sure you just want to observe?
Of course that's fine, but are you sure you just want to watch?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I think I understand my situation.
My condition is improving, but...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
That's why we can't afford to push ourselves too hard.
The Shinzan Kinen is in January,
which would leave very little turnaround time between races.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: That's why.........

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ............Just watching is fine!
choice_data_list: (You held out so well, Ai! Good job!)
(You did so well to endure it, Ai!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was decided that we would go watch the
Hanshin Juvenile Fillies
to see Lucky Lilac run.
